proposal.description: The S_RUN trip is evaluated only on the cycle-boundary strobe pwm_rise, as if the trip were sampled with the window, instead of following the run count continuously.
proposal.reason: The run count takes its new value on the clock edge that ends the pwm_rise clock, so a count that reaches trip_run only raises window_trip at the next pwm_rise. That is a whole switching cycle late, and window_trip is then a one-clock pulse instead of a level held while the count is at or above trip_run in S_RUN.

proposal.description: A TRIP_RUN threshold of zero is treated as 'S_RUN window trip disabled' instead of 'trip at any count'.
proposal.reason: With trip_run programmed to 0, the original asserts window_trip as soon as run_active is high, because count >= 0 is always true. The mutant never asserts window_trip in S_RUN, whatever overcurrent is sampled.

after: always_comb window_trip_SS = ss_active  && ((fault_count_ss + FCNT_SS_W'(pwm_rise & cp_delay[BLANK_CLKS-1])) >= trip_ss);
proposal.description: The soft-start trip looks ahead at the sample being taken on pwm_rise, adding the entering bit without subtracting the leaving bit, instead of comparing the registered count.
proposal.reason: In S_SS, on a pwm_rise clock where the blanked sample is faulted and fault_count_ss is trip_ss-1, window_trip_SS rises one clock early. If the bit leaving the window is also faulted, the count never actually reaches trip_ss, but window_trip_SS still pulses high for that clock.

proposal.description: The blanking history cp_delay is not cleared while neither S_SS nor S_RUN is active, so it keeps tracking cp_sync through idle and hiccup.
proposal.reason: Suppose cp_sync is high during the last BLANK_CLKS clocks before S_SS is entered (after reset the CP synchroniser resets high, or the comparator is still asserted after a trip). If a pwm_rise then comes within BLANK_CLKS clocks of S_SS entry, the soft-start window counts a faulted cycle where the original counts a clean one. This raises fault_count_ss_out and can assert window_trip_SS early.
